articles.summary: Operations engineering is stuck in the past. This post breaks down why ops hasn’t had the same revolution as software development, explores the limits of DevOps, and argues for scaling expertise through reusable tools and clean abstractions. It’s time for ops to adopt lessons from software engineering and move the industry forward.
articles.title: The Missing Revolution in Operations: Scaling Expertise in a Cloud-First World

articles.summary: Learn how to implement convention-over-configuration for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using OpenTofu. Discover practical techniques to build developer-friendly IaC modules that streamline compliance, enforce business standards, and reduce operational friction.
articles.title: Convention over Configuration: Building Developer-Friendly IaC with OpenTofu

articles.summary: GitOps isn’t the right fit for modern Ops, DevOps, or platform engineering. Learn why static workflows fail to address dynamic cloud complexity and explore better tools for managing real-time infrastructure.
articles.title: GitOps is not the right tool for the job
